name: T3 Code
description: T3 Code is an open-source control surface for coding agents. It provides a web interface for orchestrating local Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build and OpenCode sessions from remote devices.

notes.text: The service runs as the dedicated non-root t3 user. Add projects and install/authenticate provider CLIs as that user; this script does not copy credentials or install provider CLIs.
After installation, run su - t3 and then npx --yes t3@latest pair to create a one-time pairing link. Treat pairing links as passwords.
The service listens on all interfaces at TCP port 3773 over HTTP. Restrict access to a trusted network or place it behind HTTPS before exposing it beyond your private network.
The arm64 path has not been tested yet. Native node-pty dependencies may require a successful build on the target architecture.
